Agent Name: GameTheory_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The first error is in the GameTheory_Expert’s reasoning when they try to enumerate feasible coin distributions. They incorrectly derive and list impossible distributions such as \((12,6,18)\), \((10,7,17)\), etc., which do not sum to 30 and do not satisfy the intended “one box has 6 more coins than another” condition in a consistent way. More importantly, they misunderstand the game’s objective: Bob submits three guesses in advance and wins only the guessed amount for each box when the guess does not exceed the actual count. To guarantee a minimum payoff, Bob must choose a strategy that works against every valid arrangement, not simply guess one particular feasible distribution. Their conclusion that Bob can guarantee all 30 coins is unsupported and false.
